crossRefs.note: The three sons of Zeruiah were there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.
Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,
Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,
He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.
This news came to Joab; for Joab had followed Adonijah, although he didn’t follow Absalom. Joab fled to Yahweh’s Tent…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

people.name: Zeruiah
people.line: Sister of David; mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel

translations.web: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
translations.bsb: So Joab son of Zeruiah and the servants of David marched out and met them by the pool of Gibeon. And the two groups took up positions on opposite sides of the pool.
translations.kjv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
translations.asv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
